name: sdp_sqrt2_td50
description: Same problem as golden/sdp_sqrt2 (data file identical apart from the header comment): 2x2 SDP max x_12 s.t. x_11=1, x_22=2, X 2x2 PSD. opt = sqrt(2); X* = [[1,sqrt(2)],[sqrt(2),2]] is a rank-1 boundary optimum with a rank-1 dual slack S* (strict complementarity). Run at target_digits=50 (bead arb-prec-IPM-h62): the regime where lambda_min(S) ~ mu falls far below any absolute float64 constant in Layer 0.
reference_method: Reused verbatim from golden/sdp_sqrt2/provenance.json (closed form sqrt(2) via Cauchy-Schwarz / Schur complement; N[Sqrt[2],65] in Mathematica). The 65-digit reference resolves the 50-digit target with 15 digits to spare.

known_gaps.reason: Measured 2026-11-10 after h62 (point-mode midpoints) and pw1 (no S jitter): the first OPTIMAL candidate appears at prec 1024 (22 iterations, 64.2 matched digits); its confirming solve needs 2048 > prec_cap 1024, so the adaptive status is LIMIT. The 512-bit solve reaches mu = 5e-48 in 17 iterations, then the residual of the primal Newton equation jumps from ~1e-37 to 1e-11 within two iterations (error growth ~mu^-3 against unit roundoff 1e-154) and it STALLs: an open direction-numerics defect. Before the fixes: candidate at 2048 after 260 iterations.

Measured 2026-11-10 after h62 and pw1: 22 iterations (meets the 22 budget) at final_prec 1024 = 16 bits per matched digit against the 11 budget, which a 512-bit solve would meet; same open direction-numerics defect as the correctness gap.
